name: Magny-Cours
summary: The French Grand Prix's home from 1991 to 2008, deep in rural France.
character: A smooth surface and corners named after other tracks, like the Adelaide hairpin and the Estoril curve.

moments.title: Four stops to win
moments.body: In 2004 Ferrari put Michael Schumacher on a four-stop strategy to get past Fernando Alonso, and it worked.

history.body: First French Grand Prix at Magny-Cours.

leftCalendar: Remote and short of money, it lost the French Grand Prix after 2008. France came back in 2018 at Paul Ricard.
